segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to walk through the updated quote for 42 seats, confirm the July 15 go-live, and make sure the invoice setup matches what your finance team asked for.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, that works. I reviewed the quote this morning. The seat count is right for phase one. We may add another 8 or 10 in October, but 42 is the number for now.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. So the annual subscription is $31,080, billed annually, and the implementation package is $4,500 one time. I also added the standard admin training, two sessions, no extra charge.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. On the implementation fee, can that be invoiced separately from the subscription? Our operations budget covers that, but the license fee comes from IT.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, we can split that into two invoices. I’ll note that in the billing tool: one invoice for $31,080 to IT, one for $4,500 to operations. Same PO, or do you need separate POs?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Separate POs. I should have them by Friday. Also, we need net 30 terms, not due on receipt.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. Net 30 is already in the order form, and I’ll make sure both invoices reflect that. Contract term is July 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027, with the platform live date targeted for July 15.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That matches our timeline. Legal had one comment on the renewal language. They want 60 days notice instead of 30 for non-renewal.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, that’s fine. I’ll send that to deal desk today, but that change is usually approved without issue. I should have the revised order form back to you tomorrow afternoon.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. If you send it by end of day tomorrow, I can route for signature Monday and keep the kickoff on June 24.
